recipes.name: Fluffy Vegan Pancakes
instructions: Place a sieve over a large bowl and sift in the flour and baking powder. Then, add the sugar and salt. Mix well.
Add the milk, vinegar, and vanilla and mix until just combined. Make sure to not overmix, it’s okay if a few lumps remain. Let the batter rest for 3 minutes.
Heat a non-stick crêpe pan over medium-high heat. Add oil as needed, and pour on ¼ cup of the pancake batter for each pancake.
Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, or until the top is bubbly and the bottom is golden. Then flip and cook the other side until golden. Continue with the remaining batter.
Serve with jam, maple syrup, and fruit if desired, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † We recommend either soy or pea milk for this recipe as the high protein content is what curdles to create vegan buttermilk.

Storage The pancakes are best when enjoyed immediately. Store leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days. To freeze, let the pancakes cool completely then freeze in a single layer on a baking sheet. When frozen, transfer to an airtight container. Store in the freezer for up to 2 months. Reheat on the stove or in a toaster when ready to enjoy.
